topic: Breath series 2: Coherence breathing (animated, promotes the app)
caption:
Coherence breathing: slow, even breaths at about six a minute, with no holds.

Your heart rate naturally rises a little as you breathe in and eases as you breathe out. Breathing slowly makes that rise and fall bigger. A review of more than 200 studies found slow breathing changed heart rhythm while people practised and for a short time afterwards, though most of those studies had design weaknesses. A recent review of nine small studies found people who breathed slowly before bed often rated their sleep as better, while sleep measured by devices showed mixed results.

How to try it: breathe in for five seconds, then out for five, smoothly and not too big. If you feel light-headed, go back to your usual breathing.

You can practise coherence breathing with the free guided breathing in our Tools and Courses app. Find it in our profile links.

Save this for later.
